metadata.title: Privacy policy
metadata.description: Information about how na.digital processes personal data collected through the contact form and other means.

hero.pe_scurt_colectam_doar_ce_ne_dai_nu_vind: In short: we collect only what you give us, we sell nothing, and we delete it when it is no longer needed.

cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.draft_de_verificat_juridic_inainte_de_pu: Draft · to be reviewed by legal counsel before publication
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.aici_afli_ce_date_ne_lasi_cand_folosesti: Here you can find out what data you leave when you use the na.digital website, what we do with it, and how you can ask us to change or delete it. Last updated: [DATA].
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.operatorul_datelor_este_numele_pfa_cui_c: The data controller is [NUMELE PFA], tax ID [CUI], Trade Registry no. [NR. ÎNREGISTRARE], with registered office at [ADRESA SEDIULUI]. On the website and social media, it operates under the name na.digital. For any questions about your data, write to [EMAIL].
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.ce_date_colectam_de_ce_si_cat_le_pastram: What data we collect, why, and how long we keep it
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.colectam_doar_ce_ne_dai_tu_in_situatiile: We collect only what you give us, in the situations described below. The legal bases are those in Article 6(1) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.number_12_luni_de_la_ultima_discutie_dac: [12 LUNI] from the last conversation, if we do not work together

cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.nume_email_data_si_ora_alese: name, email, selected date and time
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.number_30_de_zile_daca_nu_te_ai_abonat_s: [30 DE ZILE], if you have not also subscribed to the newsletter

cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.interesul_nostru_legitim_de_a_raspunde_l: our legitimate interest in replying (point f)
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.sa_lucram_impreuna_si_sa_tinem_contabili: to work together and maintain accounting records

cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.ce_nu_facem_cu_datele_tale: What we do not do with your data
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.nu_le_vindem_nu_le_inchiriem_si_nu_le_da: We do not sell or rent it, or give it to others to advertise to you.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.nu_luam_decizii_automate_despre_tine_si: We do not make automated decisions about you or create a profile of you.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.nu_te_abonam_la_newsletter_daca_nu_ai_bi: We do not subscribe you to the newsletter unless you have separately opted in.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.pastram_datele_doar_cat_e_nevoie_pentru: We keep data only for as long as needed for the reason you provided it, then delete it. The period for each situation is set out in the table above. If you ask us to delete it sooner, we will do so, except for documents that the law requires us to retain.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.cine_mai_vede_datele: Who else may see the data
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.lucram_cu_cativa_furnizori_care_ne_ajuta: We work with a few providers that help keep our website and communications running. They process data only on our behalf, under contract, and cannot use it for another purpose.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.trimiterea_listei_gratuite_si_a_newslett: sending the free checklist and newsletter
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.daca_un_furnizor_stocheaza_datele_in_afa: If a provider stores data outside the European Economic Area, the transfer is made only with the safeguards required by the GDPR, such as the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses. [DE VERIFICAT PENTRU FIECARE FURNIZOR]
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.pe_paginile_noastre_de_instagram_si_tikt: On our Instagram and TikTok pages, the platforms process your data according to their own privacy policies. We may disclose data to authorities only where required by law.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.ce_cookies_folosim_si_cum_iti_dai_acordu: Learn which cookies we use and how to give your consent in
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.oricand_ne_poti_cere: At any time, you may ask us to:
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.sa_afli_ce_date_avem_despre_tine_si_sa_p: find out what data we hold about you and receive a copy;
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.sa_le_folosim_mai_putin_pana_lamurim_o_p: restrict our use while we resolve an issue;
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.sa_ti_le_dam_intr_un_format_pe_care_il_p: provide it in a format you can transfer elsewhere;
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.sa_nu_le_mai_folosim_pe_baza_interesului: stop using it on the basis of our legitimate interest;
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.sa_iti_retragi_acordul_de_exemplu_pentru: withdraw your consent, for example for the newsletter. Processing carried out beforehand remains lawful.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.ne_scrii_la_email_si_iti_raspundem_in_ce: Write to [EMAIL] and we will reply within one month. You can unsubscribe from the newsletter directly through the link at the end of every email.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.daca_crezi_ca_nu_ne_am_purtat_corect_cu: If you believe we have not handled your data properly, you may lodge a complaint with the National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP): 28-30 General Gheorghe Magheru Blvd., District 1, Bucharest, postal code 010336, anspdcp@dataprotection.ro, +40 318 059 211,
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.datele_stau_doar_la_furnizorii_de_mai_su: Data is stored only with the providers listed above and in our accounts, protected by passwords and two-factor authentication. Only the na.digital founders have access. [CONFIRMAȚI CĂ AȘA E]
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.serviciile_noastre_sunt_pentru_firme_si: Our services are for businesses and adults. We do not knowingly collect data from people under 16.
cine_are_grija_de_datele_tale.daca_politica_se_schimba_actualizam_data: If the policy changes, we update the date at the beginning. If the change is significant and you subscribe to the newsletter, we will also tell you by email.
